rationale: The workflow runs three independent macOS Flutter build jobs (iOS app, IPA archive, macOS app) via workflow_dispatch/workflow_call, each using checkout, setup-xcode, and the local reusable action .github/actions/flutter-common before building and uploading artifacts. The closest evidence-supported pattern is P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching), but its precondition requires confirming no equivalent cache already exists and that cache inputs cover the lockfile/environment. The dependency setup is delegated to .github/actions/flutter-common, whose contents are not in the provided repository context, so I cannot verify whether it already caches Flutter/Dart/CocoaPods dependencies or identify correct cache paths; adding a cache blindly risks redundancy or missing the actual dependency directories. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not supported because only a single CI run (~7.5 min) exists, which is not representative successful-duration history, and macOS Flutter builds can be slow enough that a guessed limit risks failing valid runs (contraindication). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply (no matrix). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is simulation-estimate evidence and the workflow_call/workflow_dispatch ref model risks grouping distinct refs/branches in one cancellation group, which could affect required-check coverage. Other patterns require build-configuration changes, test selection (the contract requires the full build), or CI-service policies not present here. No optimization has verified prerequisites, so no change is made.
